title: 95% sikker på TickTock er en KINESISK app
body:
De skjuler det godt, men min online research og mavefornemmelse gør mig 95% sikker på at TickTick er en kinesisk app. Uanset at virksomheden er registreret i USA og at "de fleste af medarbejderne "sidder i USA". Det kan kinesere også gøre 😉

Firmaet hedder Appest, de har en kinesisk version af TickTick som hedder DIDA – og deres direktør er kineser.

Needless to say: er ikke en god app at installere på
din telefon. Al software du installerer kan gøre alskens hacker-tricks, osv. Handler IKKE kun om hvorvidt du er ligeglad med at dele med CCP (det kinesiske kommunist parti) at du ska købe mælk og toiletpapir.

title: Love the app ❤️, but a request if I may?
body:
My favorite app as it enables voice memos, audio attachments, timer, and calendar in one :)! Only one I’ve found that does all of that by itself!

Some concerns;
1. When I add an attachment to “repeat daily” tasks, it duplicates them across all the days. Which can be forever… Can you make it so that the attachments don’t duplicate and stay individual? Or at least as an option? 

2. Don’t know if this is on purpose or not, but when template adds to folder and I moves it again to another folder, it deletes the root template task and all the subtasks become tasks.

Also an idea;
Option to add timer to tasks. You can press a button on a task and it starts counting based on ‘individual task timer settings’ decided on. And when timer ends task gets automatically completed.
Perhaps also to habits.

Best of wishes,
From me

title: A lot like Apple Reminders in design but better
body: TickTick has become my friend over the past couple of months. I was very used to Apple Reminders on my devices, so it was difficult to try something new, which was not automatically integrated in iCloud services. Normally that would be an issue to me due to the lack of simplicity, but the features which are packed in the app TickTick does a difference. Take the behavioral feature called “Habits”, it has completely changed my mindset towards things I need to become better at. Right now my focus is to drink more water, because I feel demotivated completing my tasks when I’m dehydrated. It has helped me a lot by using such an integrated feature. The reason why I’m not providing full stars in my review is, that I believe dark mode should be a complementary feature these days, and I would also like to see a board like view as we can have in an app like Trello. Combining Project boards with Reminders would be the absolute go to app for me personally.

title: The best
body:
I am truly impressed with the features of TickTick and the way they've been packed nicely into a great interface.
I'm not paying, it's expensive for me as a student, and generally I dislike monthly payment (if there was an affordable one time fee I'd buy it), but the free features are plenty so I'm very happy with that so far.
One specific feature I was looking for was a "blank canvas" every day while still having yesterday's and all the other day's undone to-do's easily and clearly accessed when wanted. It's actually a rare feature and was what I liked a lot about Microsoft Todo, while that's a pretty poor experience otherwise, so I'm glad I found one that has that plus everything I missed from MS. I've used maaaany task managers, they play a big role in my everyday, and Ticktick makes them all look like toys.
